integrity.proof_basis: Complete acyclic matching on ordinary face poset and standard finite discrete Morse theorem.
integrity.reproducibility: Two self-contained standard-library Python programs supplied as source files.

scientific_limitations: Only the stated 24-vertex McGee graph and ordinary independence complex are classified, not a graph family.
The exact acyclic matching is verified on every nonempty face and incidence; finite calculations make no assertion about infinite graph families.
Possibility of a prior equivalent unindexed calculation cannot be excluded by bibliographic searches.
title: The McGee graph independence complex is a five-sphere
